verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's API lets developers pull profile/event data programmatically (docs-18, docs-21, docs-30), which could technically retrieve contacts and engagement history, but there is no documented self-serve UI export tool, no mention of exporting suppression lists, tags, or custom fields together, and no open-format bulk export feature a non-technical founder could use directly. Missing for 10: a documented self-serve export/download feature, explicit suppression-list export, and confirmation of open-format (CSV) full-audience export without requiring API/developer work.
